# Wraith Form

https://slay-the-spire.fandom.com/wiki/Wraith_Form

**Infobox:**
- Name: Wraith Form
- Image: https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/slay-the-spire/images/e/ec/WraithForm.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/268?cb=20181016212246
- Class: Silent
- Type: Power
- Rarity: Rare
- Cost: 3
- Effect: Gain 2 Intangible.; At the end of your turn, lose 1 Dexterity.
- [Wraith Form+]
- Cost+: 3
- Effect+: Gain 3 Intangible.; At the end of your turn, lose 1 Dexterity.
- Name: Wraith Form
- Image: https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/slay-the-spire/images/b/bd/Icon_WraithForm.png/revision/latest?cb=20200202234705
- Description: Lose X Dexterity at the end of your turn.
- Type: Debuff
- Stacking; Behavior: Intensity

**Wraith Form** is a Power card for The Silent.

Note that the Dexterity loss stacks. So after playing 2 Wraith Forms you will lose 2 Dexterity at the end of each turn.

The continuous Dexterity loss is a debuff, and can therefore be prevented if you have Artifact in place before using Wraith Form, or halted by using Orange Pellets afterwards.

## Synergy
- Wraith Form can be amazing in a Blur or Calipers run, where you can stockpile a ton of block in advance of losing all your Dexterity, but if you're running this deck you're already winning.

- Wraith Form works very well with any source of Block that isn't affected by Dexterity.
    - After Image
    - Ornamental Fan
    - Orichalcum
- It can be less harmful if you can gain Dexterity.
    - Footwork
    - Kunai

## Old Wraith Form
This was reworked on April 12, 2018 (Patch 20), from the following effect: Whenever you play a skill, deal 3 (5) damage to a random enemy.

# Wrath

https://slay-the-spire.fandom.com/wiki/Wrath

Wrath is one of the three Stances of the Watcher, with the others being Calm and Divinity.

While in this Stance, deal and receive double damage.
## Related
### Cards
These cards allow you to enter Wrath:
- Eruption: Deal damage then enter Wrath. 
- Crescendo: Enter Wrath.
- Indignation: Enter Wrath.
- Simmering Fury: Enter Wrath at the beginning of the next turn.
- Tantrum: Deal damage then enter Wrath.
These cards have interactions specifically for Wrath:
- Halt: Gain additional Block if you are in Wrath.
- Indignation: If in Wrath when played, apply Vulnerable to ALL enemies.
- Rushdown: Draw cards whenever you enter Wrath.
### Other
- Stance Potion: Gives you a choice to enter Wrath.

## Trivia
- While in Wrath, the eye on the Watcher's staff is open and unblinking. The eyeball turns red and slightly, but rapidly, shakes in place.

# Wreath of Flame

https://slay-the-spire.fandom.com/wiki/Wreath_of_Flame

**Infobox:**
- Name: Wreath of Flame
- Image: https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/slay-the-spire/images/d/d8/WreathofFlame.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/268?cb=20191017204255
- Class: Watcher
- Type: Skill
- Rarity: Uncommon
- Cost: 1
- Effect: Your next Attack deals 5 additional damage.
- [Wreath of Flame+]
- Cost+: 1
- Effect+: Your next Attack deals 8 additional damage.
- Name: Vigor
- Image: https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/slay-the-spire/images/3/3a/Icon_Vigor.png/revision/latest?cb=20200202234657
- Description: Your next Attack deals X additional damage.
- Type: Buff
- Stacking; Behavior: Intensity

CardAutobox

**Wreath of Flame** is a Skill card for the Watcher. It adds 5 stacks of the Vigor buff (8 stacks if  Upgraded), making the next Attack played deal additional damage per hit.

This effect is applied to every hit of an attack, and before multipliers, making it exceptionally powerful when stacked with multiplying effects:

- Wrath
- Divinity
- Vulnerable
- Multi-hit attacks (e.g: Ragnarok, Flying Sleeves or Bowling Bash)

## Mechanics

- Playing Wreath of Flame multiple times will increase the amount of Vigor. It stacks with Akabeko, which also gives Vigor.
- If an Attack hits multiple times, or hits multiple enemies, Vigor applies to every instance of damage from that Attack.
- Vigor does not expire at the end of the turn; it is only removed after playing an Attack.

# Wrist Blade

https://slay-the-spire.fandom.com/wiki/Wrist_Blade

**Infobox:**
- Name: Wrist Blade
- Image: https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/slay-the-spire/images/e/e0/WristBlade.png/revision/latest?cb=20200203153337
- Description: Attacks that cost 0 deal 4 additional damage.
- Flavor: Handy for assassinations.
- Rarity: Boss
- Class: Silent

Attacks that cost 0 Energy deal 4 additional damage. 

It affects any 0 cost Attack cards, regardless of class. As a result, cards like Anger, Claw, or Flurry of Blows when obtained from Prismatic Shard work with this relic.

It also applies to cards that have had their cost reduced to 0, such as cards with cost changed by Confused, Blood for Blood, Eviscerate, Streamline, or cards Retained under Establishment.

## Synergies

- Shivs are the most obvious use for this relic, being a passive and sizable buff, however it applies to natural 0-cost cards like Neutralize as well.
- Bullet Time reduces all card costs in hand to 0 for the turn, giving ALL attacks 4 extra damage.
- Setup and Forethought reduce the cost of one card to 0 until played, which can be used on an attack to buff it. (In the case of Forethought+, can be used on your entire hand)
- Snecko Eye may reduce cost to 0 when you draw an attack.
- Attack Potion sets the cost of the given attack to 0 for the turn.
- Liquid Memories sets the cost of the retrieved card to 0 for the turn.

- Swivel sets your next attack cost to 0.

## Trivia
- This relic is a reference to Assassin's Creed as supported by the quote "Handy for assassinations".

# Writhing Mass

https://slay-the-spire.fandom.com/wiki/Writhing_Mass

**Infobox:**
- Name: Writhing Mass
- Image: https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/slay-the-spire/images/5/5f/Writhing_Mass.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/268?cb=20181019060504
- HP: 160; 175 (Ascension 7+)
- In Party With: None
- Debut Act: Act 3
- Powers: Malleable 3; Reactive
- Name: Malleable
- Image: https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/slay-the-spire/images/4/42/Icon_Mallable.png/revision/latest?cb=20200202163411
- Description: Upon receiving attack damage, gains X Block. Block gain increases by 1 each time Malleable is triggered. Resets to X at the start of your turn.
- Type: Buff
- Stacking; Behavior: Intensity
- Name: Reactive
- Image: https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/slay-the-spire/images/8/89/Icon_Reactive.png/revision/latest?cb=20200202163652
- Description: Upon receiving attack damage, changes its intent.
- Type: Buff
- Stacking; Behavior: None

The **Writhing Mass** is an enemy encountered in Act 3. It is unique in that it is the only enemy that can permanently add a card to the player's deck.

## Pattern
The Writhing Mass has an equal chance of using Multi-Strike, Strong Strike, Flail, or Wither on the first turn.

Afterwards, it has a 10% chance of using Implant, 30% chance of using Flail, 20% chance of using Wither, 30% chance of using Multi-Strike and 10% chance of using Strong Strike every turn. These chances also apply when changing intent due to its innate Reactive buff.

The Writhing Mass can use Implant only once per combat and cannot use a move twice in a row*; additionally, its intent will *always** change when Reactive is activated.

*Due to the coding of Writhing Mass, *after* Implant was used, when the current intent is Strong Strike, there is a 1 in 90 chance that the next intent is *also* Strong Strike, tested 7/30/2025.
| Name | Intent | Effect | Asc 2+ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Implant |  | Permanently adds a Parasite to your deck. | Permanently adds a Parasite to your deck. |
| Flail |  | Deal 15 damage, gain 16 Block. | Deal 16 damage, gain 18 Block. |
| Wither |  | Deal 10 damage, apply 2 Weak and 2 Vulnerable. | Deal 12 damage, apply 2 Weak and 2 Vulnerable. |
| Multi-Strike |  | Deal 7 x 3 damage. | Deal 9 x 3 damage. |
| Strong Strike |  | Deal 32 damage. | Deal 38 damage. |

# Zap

https://slay-the-spire.fandom.com/wiki/Zap

**Infobox:**
- Name: Zap
- Image: https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/slay-the-spire/images/0/0b/Zap.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/268?cb=20181016203836
- Class: Defect
- Type: Skill
- Rarity: Basic
- Cost: 1
- Effect: Channel 1 Lightning.
- [Zap+]
- Cost+: 0
- Effect+: Channel 1 Lightning.

**Zap** is a starting card for The Defect that channels 1 Lightning Orb.

Upgrading **Zap** reduces its Energy cost from 1 to 0.

As a starting card, Zap can only be obtained mid-run through events such as Match and Keep or A Note For Yourself.

## Strategy
**Zap** is a cornerstone of The Defect's strategic arsenal; you'll rarely have a reason not to upgrade it, let alone cut it. Zap is the most consistent way to generate the most consistent Orb, and can Evoke an Orb in a pinch.

Upgrading Zap is strongly recommended. Not only does it make Zap easier to fit into a turn, it enables All for One and Scrape to generate Lightning Orbs.
